name: 체형 비율 분석
description: Detects unnatural body proportions in AI-generated video content.
useCase: Identifying AI-generated humans through body gradient analysis
mechanism: Divides frames into horizontal strips and measures gradient energy distribution. Natural human bodies create specific top-middle-bottom gradient patterns that AI often fails to replicate.
source: Agarwal et al. (2020) - Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Phoneme-Viseme Mismatches
parameters: Block size: adaptive, Analysis region: face/body, Metrics: gradient energy, variance ratio
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated video artifacts
- Works across different video resolutions
- Complements other forensic analysis methods
- Low computational overhead per frame
limitations:
- Requires video input (not applicable to images)
- May produce false positives on heavily processed videos
- Performance varies with video quality
- Single-frame analysis limits temporal assessment

references.title: Agarwal et al. (2020) - Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Phoneme-Viseme Mismatches
Nguyen, H. et al. (2019). Deep Learning for Deepfakes Creation and Detection: A Survey. arXiv.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Fake Detection. Information Fusion.
